author: extremeorange
quote: i get the 13 years of waiting. sure its a huge game, but as we go with the story you'll realize there's not much effort in it, for that much of a budget and 13 years of developing time they had they could've made the story a bit creative to say at least, the whole game expects you to coddle lucia all the time, which ruined the fun. and lets not talk about the over sexuality and unneccesaey realism in the game, they just made it impossible to play on 60 fps???? is that supposed to be good? and if we be honest the whole over-sexualizing stuff is really really uncomfortable, only those sick in the head enjoy it, its overglazed not worth a penny and one of the biggest regrets, wish i get refunded. rockstar thinking they can pull players by giving them as people say "fan services" is just so wrong. and they've restrained so much stuff in the game due to "making the game as if its real life" it ruined the whole point of gta!! those who defend it know its a horrible game giving what they had of potential, too much salt ruins the dish!!. so please stop giving it more than what it deserves you're not tricking anyone but yourself. and whats even more irritating it took over tons of better games like zelda!!! like how's that even a thing??? and no this is not a review bomb, just because i dont like it and gave an honest opinion doesnt mean i am review bombing
